- Usage: monthly tokens +18% vs plan (bounding ETA on QPS increases).
- Security: SOC2 evidence up-to-date; need to confirm snapshot retention policy in their VPC config.
- Commercial: customer flagged for potential credits due to the May impact; likely a small concession request.

Planned deliverables for QBR:
1) One-page executive summary (15 min) — Jordan to lead.
2) Technical RCA + mitigation timeline (10 min) — Tessa / Eng to provide.
3) Commercial proposal (pricing + potential credit) (5–10 min) — Laura / Aditya to draft.

Attachments to prepare: health_snapshot_20270601.csv (I attached our usage and incidents export).

Immediate asks:
- Jordan: can you draft the exec one-pager and call out three priority asks for Redwood leadership?
- Tessa: confirm ETA on the final RCA and whether any customer-facing remediation remains.
- Laura & Aditya: run through the commercial concession bounds — what's ok to pre-approve vs what needs exec sign-off?

Let's aim to have draft materials by 6/9 so we can review before we propose July slots.

Thanks — Grace

- If we offer an upfront credit we should balance with a comms plan that highlights the mitigations we've implemented.

I attached a redline of the proposed renewal concession language to keep it conservative (proposed_pricing_redline.docx).

Executive one-paragraph summary:
Stratus Analytics experienced a brief latency regression in mid-May resulting in elevated token usage and operational noise. Mitigation applied; root cause points to cache hot-sharding that we have since addressed. Renewal window opens 7/15; customer is assessing request for a commercial credit.

Three exec attention items (what I will call out in the QBR):
1) Operational risk & remediation: final RCA acceptance and timeline for any lasting changes (ops/eng). Need sign-off on the mitigation schedule.
2) Commercial posture: we can pre-authorize up to 7% credit. Anything above requires revenue manager + CRO approval. Request: sales leadership to confirm a recommended ask (no more than two scenarios).
3) Evidence & compliance: Stratus asked for retention policy confirmation and SOC2 artifacts for the last 12 months. Ask: Security to confirm timeline for providing the bundle.

Proposed next steps:
- Produce exec one-pager by 6/9 (Jordan).
- Final RCA and customer-facing mitigation summary by 6/9 (Tessa).
- Commercial proposal (0–7% scenario + escalation path) by 6/7 (Laura/Aditya).

I will also prepare a 3-slide deck: 1) health snapshot, 2) RCA summary + timeline, 3) proposed commercial ask and approval path.

Attachment: exec_one_pager.pdf (placeholder)

Jordan Blake
Director, Customer Success Operations
